ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of Medicaid fraud cases, including the Feeding Our Future fraud case and the Fishing Point Healthcare investigation.
questions: How much money is being lost to Medicaid fraud?
What are the most common schemes used to commit Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover the scope of Medicaid fraud and identify patterns and connections between entities and programs.
